defaults.device_setting: a silver MacBook Pro standing open on a warm natural oak table, a soft linen cloth and a ceramic cup at the edge of frame, a sunlit cream plaster wall behind
defaults.tagline_integration: as large refined serif letters standing physically on the table behind the product, softly lit, casting real shadows
defaults.palette_base: cream, warm beige, natural oak, soft off-white
defaults.sound_hint: soft ambient room tone, a glassy shimmer as the product breaks the screen, a rising whoosh through the transformation, a deep satisfying sub-hit and silence on the hero
defaults.drawn_style: fine white ink hand-drawn line art, slightly imperfect pen strokes
defaults.device_setting_short: silver MacBook Pro open on a warm oak table, cream plaster wall, linen cloth

visual_theme.motion: one continuous camera move: slow handheld push-in, accelerating orbit through the transformation, decelerating into a locked symmetrical hero frame
visual_theme.mood: minimal luxury, calm → wonder → euphoric rush → elegant stillness

negatives: no distorted or melted product shape
no floating text overlays or subtitles
mj_negatives: random objects, distorted product, misspelled text, extra letters, watermark, people, hands, clutter

stages.title: Digital → Physical
stages.description_he: האתר נראה רגיל לגמרי — כבר בשנייה הראשונה {{product_he}} מתחיל לפרוץ את זכוכית המסך ויוצא לעולם הפיזי.
stages.video_prompt: Vertical 9:16, one continuous shot. {{video_realism}} The website on the laptop looks completely normal, then within the first second {{product_short}} begins to physically push out through the screen glass — {{emergence}}. {{drawn_s1}} Slow handheld push-in, real reflections and shadows on the oak table. The giant letters {{hero_word_q}} start to lift off the web page. Calm, premium, magical. {{negatives_short}}

stages.title: Transformation
stages.description_he: המוצר בחוץ; האותיות הענקיות הופכות לאובייקטים פיזיים מ-{{letter_material}}; {{transformation_he}} — התנועה מאיצה עד לשיא.
stages.video_prompt: Continuous shot, the camera orbits and pushes closer with accelerating speed. {{video_realism}} {{transformation_c}}. The huge letters {{hero_word_q}} are solid {{letter_material}}, some behind {{product_short}}, some in front of it. {{particles_c}} move with real gravity and depth; motion builds to a euphoric peak. Product shape and branding stay accurate. {{negatives_short}}

stages.title: Hero
stages.description_he: התנועה נבלמת בבת אחת לאלגנטיות איטית ומתיישבת על שוט הירו מושלם; הטאגליין {{tagline_q}} משולב בסצנה.
stages.video_prompt: Continuous shot. {{video_realism}} The motion suddenly turns elegant and slow, everything settles with soft inertia, the camera decelerates and locks into a perfectly symmetrical frame: {{hero_shot}}. {{tagline_clause}} Soft daylight, a last drift of {{particles_first}}. Premium, still, iconic. {{negatives_short}}

keyframes.label: K0 — plain website
keyframes.prompt: {{shot_style}}. {{device_setting_c}}. On the laptop screen: {{website}}{{drawn_website}} Everything is completely normal and calm — nothing has emerged yet. The laptop fills the central two thirds of the frame, slightly angled toward camera. {{realism}} {{theme}}
keyframes.mj_prompt: {{device_setting_short}}, the laptop screen shows {{website}}{{mj_drawn_k0}}, everything calm and normal, laptop fills the center of the vertical frame, {{mj_style}}

keyframes.label: K1 — product half-out
keyframes.prompt: {{shot_style}}, the exact same laptop, table, wall and light as the reference scene. {{product_short_c}} is physically emerging from the laptop screen: {{emergence}}. About half of the product is already out in the real room, casting a real contact shadow on the oak table; the rest is still inside the website. {{drawn_k1}} {{k1_letters}} {{realism}} {{theme}}
keyframes.mj_prompt: {{product_short}} physically bursting out of a MacBook screen onto a warm oak table: {{emergence}}, half of it still inside the screen{{mj_drawn_k1}}{{mj_letters_k1}}, real contact shadow, {{mj_style}}

keyframes.label: K2 — transformation peak
keyframes.prompt: {{shot_style}}, a surreal moment captured for real — same oak table and cream wall, the camera now closer and slightly orbited. The peak of a magical transformation: {{transformation}}. {{k2_letters}} {{particles_c}} frozen mid-motion as if shot at 1/8000s, with a hint of motion blur on the fastest elements. The laptop is still softly visible behind, its screen blending into the room. {{product_lock}} {{realism}} {{theme}}
keyframes.mj_prompt: surreal moment captured for real: {{transformation}}{{mj_letters_k2}}, {{particles}} frozen mid-air, MacBook softly out of focus behind, camera close and slightly orbited, {{mj_style}}

keyframes.label: K3 — hero
keyframes.prompt: {{shot_style}}, a premium hero packshot, perfectly composed and symmetrical: {{hero_shot}}. {{k3_tagline}} The framing echoes the opening shot — the laptop softly out of focus behind, the same oak table and cream wall. {{product_lock}} {{realism}} {{theme}}
keyframes.mj_prompt: perfectly symmetrical hero packshot: {{hero_shot}}{{mj_tagline}}, MacBook softly out of focus behind on the same oak table, {{mj_style}}

master_prompt:
Create a cinematic vertical 9:16 product advertisement in a premium editorial design style. {{realism}}

A realistic {{device_setting}} displays a beautifully designed {{website}} on its screen.

The camera slowly moves through the scene with subtle handheld realism and smooth cinematic motion.

Within the first second the digital world begins to physically come alive: {{product}} emerges from the screen — {{emergence}} — and interacts naturally with the surrounding environment. {{drawn_master}}

Large, sophisticated typography spelling {{hero_word_q}} becomes part of the physical space, oversized editorial letters made of {{letter_material}}, integrated behind, around and partially obscured by the product.

The transformation should feel physically impossible but visually believable: {{transformation}}. The movement accelerates continuously.

Objects, materials and particles ({{particles}}) move naturally with realistic gravity, reflections, shadows and depth.

The screen and physical environment seamlessly blend together. Maintain accurate product proportions and recognizable {{brand}} branding throughout.

Warm premium art direction ({{palette}}), sophisticated editorial composition, minimal luxury aesthetic, soft natural lighting, {{look_film_look}}.

The transformation then suddenly becomes elegant and slow, resolving into a clean hero shot: {{hero_shot}}, with {{tagline_q}} clearly integrated into the environment.

No random objects, no chaotic motion, no unnecessary camera cuts, no distorted products, no floating text overlays.

The entire sequence should feel like one continuous magical transformation.

hyperreal.description: Default since v2 — hyperrealistic commercial cinematography; surreal events, but every material, light and physics reads as real.
hyperreal.shot_style: Vertical 9:16 hyperrealistic commercial product photograph, indistinguishable from a real high-end camera capture
hyperreal.lighting: motivated natural window daylight from camera-left with physically accurate global illumination, soft contact shadows, real bounce light and specular highlights
hyperreal.film_look: shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with a Cooke S7/i 50mm and a Laowa probe macro for close-ups, true optical depth of field and lens breathing, micro-detail (surface pores, fibres, dust motes, fine scratches), accurate refraction and caustics in glass and liquid, subsurface scattering, real-world scale, natural film grain, ungraded-to-premium color
hyperreal.realism: Hyperrealistic: real-world materials, physically correct light, reflections, refraction and shadows; every surreal element obeys real physics and looks photographed, not rendered.
hyperreal.video_realism: Hyperrealistic live-action look, real physics, real optics.
negatives_extra: no cartoon or illustration (unless explicitly hand-drawn elements)
hyperreal.mj_negatives_extra: CGI, 3D render, plastic, cartoon, illustration, oversaturated, smooth skin, AI look
hyperreal.mj_style: hyperrealistic commercial photography, shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with Cooke 50mm, real optical depth of field, micro-detail, natural film grain, soft window daylight from the left, cream and oak palette with {{accent_color}} accents

editorial.description: v1 look — warm editorial magazine photorealism.
editorial.lighting: soft natural window daylight from camera-left, gentle warm bounce, realistic soft shadows
editorial.film_look: photorealistic premium product cinematography, 50mm-equivalent vertical frame, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, editorial magazine aesthetic
editorial.mj_style: photorealistic editorial product photography, 50mm, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, soft window daylight, cream and oak palette with {{accent_color}} accents

sketch-to-real.description: The product on the website is a hand-drawn sketch; its lines lift off the screen and solidify into the hyperreal product — drawing → reality is the S1 hook.
sketch-to-real.website_suffix: The product on the page is shown as a hand-drawn sketch ({{drawn_style}}), not a photo.
sketch-to-real.k1: The hand-drawn sketch lines of the product ({{drawn_style}}) are visibly peeling off the screen and turning into the real object mid-transition — the part still inside the screen is drawn line art, the part already out is hyperreal.
sketch-to-real.s1: The drawn sketch of the product peels off the screen line by line and solidifies into the hyperreal object.
sketch-to-real.master: The product first appears on the website as a hand-drawn sketch ({{drawn_style}}) whose lines peel off the screen and solidify into the hyperreal product.

annotations.description: Hyperreal footage + animated hand-drawn accents on top (underlines, circles, arrows, sparkles, swooshes) drawn stroke-by-stroke in the kinetic-typography layer — never baked into the AI frames.

both.description: sketch-to-real in S1 + animated hand-drawn accents in S2/S3.
both.website_suffix: The product on the page is shown as a hand-drawn sketch ({{drawn_style}}), not a photo.
both.k1: The hand-drawn sketch lines of the product ({{drawn_style}}) are visibly peeling off the screen and turning into the real object mid-transition — the part still inside the screen is drawn line art, the part already out is hyperreal.
both.s1: The drawn sketch of the product peels off the screen line by line and solidifies into the hyperreal object.
both.master: The product first appears on the website as a hand-drawn sketch ({{drawn_style}}) whose lines peel off the screen and solidify into the hyperreal product.

mj_anchor_prompt: studio packshot of {{product}}, brand name '{{brand}}' clearly printed, centered on a cream seamless background, nothing else in frame, {{mj_style}}

macro_beat.description: Extra calm brand macro between the transformation peak and the hero — the rush snaps into stillness on a close-up where the brand reads perfectly. 4 clips instead of 3. ON by default since MELT (proven 4/4/3/4 structure); set "macro_beat": false in the brief to disable.

keyframe.label: K2b — brand macro
keyframe.prompt: {{shot_style}}, an extreme macro close-up: {{macro_shot}}. Calm and still after the rush, true optical shallow depth of field. {{product_lock}} {{realism}} {{theme}}
keyframe.mj_prompt: extreme macro close-up: {{macro_shot}}, calm and still, shallow depth of field, {{mj_style}}

stage.title: Macro beat
stage.description_he: השיא נעצר בבת אחת לשקט: מאקרו של המוצר שבו שם המותג נקרא בבירור.
stage.video_prompt: Continuous shot. {{video_realism}} The rush suddenly snaps into stillness: the camera dives into an extreme macro of {{product_short}} — {{macro_shot}}. Shallow depth of field, a slow gentle drift, a few particles settling. Premium, sensual, calm. {{negatives_short}}
